name: A whole site, branched, agent-built and shipped in one take
object: Framer 3.0: Agents that build and edit a real site from a prompt, Git-style Branching for safe parallel changes, and a new Community of shared templates and components
audience: designers and small teams who build and ship whole websites in Framer
message: This video tells Framer users that version 3.0 turns the editor into something you can prompt, branch, and ship from, not just click around in.

moments.what: a glowing blue Framer glyph resolves on black, then a branch picker (main, home-2026, july-update) and a Publish and Invite bar introduce the new project chrome
an Agent chat panel sits beside a live site for a brand called HAVS; the user asks the Agent to update text styles and layout settings across the whole site, and the page rebuilds itself in place
moments.copy: Use these new text styles and layout settings and update the rest of the site.

moments.what: a more technical prompt asks for a custom code component, a draggable rotating ring of images that speeds up on scroll, and the Agent generates it live, shown working on a gallery of portrait images
moments.copy: Build a Framer code component that displays uploaded images in a draggable rotating ring that speeds up on scroll.

moments.what: a quick cut to a CMS table and a "Works everywhere" title card shows the same project scaling across many pages and breakpoints
kinetic title fragments, "Welcome to a whole new Framer," "Refine on," "Ship with your" resolve into glowing 3D glyphs and the Framer 3 logo mark
moments.copy: Welcome to a whole new Framer.

cta: "Welcome to a whole new Framer", staged as a kinetic-type closer resolving into the Framer 3 logo mark
why: Moving from a plain layout prompt to a genuinely technical one, a custom scroll-reactive code component, in the same unbroken agent session proves the pitch that this agent can handle real production work, not just starter templates.
